role: Builds the firework rocket and firework charge items from paper, gunpowder, dyes and charges, writing the explosion NBT as it matches.
scope_reason: In scope: world.conf fireworks = off only stops a rocket from launching (ItemFirework.java:22); crafting rockets and firework stars from paper, gunpowder, dyes and the shape items in a survival crafting grid is live, and CraftingManager tries this recipe on every grid change.

members.name: field_92102_a

members.name: matches
members.note: the three shapes (rocket, charge, fade) with the dye-damage throw; the charge's Explosion compound serializes in Java's insertion order (Flicker, Trail, then Colors, Type; FadeColors last), which nbtbin.c's bucket_rank restores for the bucket-mates Trail/Colors and Flicker/FadeColors

members.name: getCraftingResult
members.note: the result is built inside matches, as in Java; copy() is the interned tag index

notes: lane/idxmisc 2026-09-27: misc-fireworks-s1 (seed 1, dev) crafts in a workbench a red star, a red and blue star with glowstone, a diamond and a feather, a white creeper-face star, fades the red star lime, a two-star rocket with flight 2, a plain rocket and a flight-3 rocket with the faded star, then leaves a two-tail grid that matches nothing. On master it failed at row 52 d.ents: the star with a trail serialized Colors before Trail (both in HashMap bucket 3; the interned tag text is key-sorted, Java inserts Trail during the scan and Colors after it). Fixed in nbtbin.c write_compound (bucket_rank); test_snapshots and play_check pass with 0 mismatches, test_crafting s2 and s42 0 mismatches. The matching code is exact against the oracle probe (test_crafting.c compares thrown class names); the item itself is switched off, so the recipe never matters in play. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was switched_off/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit).
